candidates.title: Rain-Damaged Lantern
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, fox and rabbit discovered their lantern had gone dark just before the evening procession before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they replaced the wick, but water kept dripping onto the flame; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized a narrow crack around the glass cover was letting in the rain; they planned a safer joint response.
With the visiting readers watching, they sealed the crack with resin and carried the relit lantern to the procession, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: Missing Storybook
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, fox and rabbit discovered the children's storybook had vanished from its wooden box before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they searched the reading tent, but only an empty ribbon was left behind; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized a scrap of matching ribbon was caught beneath a loose bench; they planned a safer joint response.
With the visiting readers watching, they lifted the bench together and returned the book before story time, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: Runaway Festival Ball
story_beats: At the snowy meadow, fox and rabbit discovered the festival's painted ball rolled downhill toward a flooded ditch before the library opened, leaving the visiting readers waiting.
Rabbit tried to isolate the problem first, but they chased it directly, but the slippery bank forced them to stop; fox stopped the attempt before further damage.
Fox compared the failed attempt with the evidence and realized a fallen branch could guide the ball into a shallow puddle instead; they planned a safer joint response.

With the visiting readers watching, they positioned the branch safely and recovered the ball without entering the ditch, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
